This policy explains recording on Saathum — audio calls, video calls, live video, and
    consultations — and what the AI receptionist captures when it answers a call for you. It is
    part of our
web-recording.8a5438ca6e767c75: We do not record your calls in the background.
web-recording.7230daecb28d6c6c:
A one-to-one or group call is
    not recorded by Saathum simply because it happens on our platform.
web-recording.0c40b3d88e724286: A recording can exist in only two situations:
web-recording.286b63ca97b0abf8:
, using a recording feature in the app
      where one is available for that call type.
web-recording.9c4a44abf0367789: The AI receptionist answers a call
web-recording.d04587113625d0d9:
Separately, anyone on a call can record it with tools outside Saathum — a screen recorder, a
    second phone, a camera. No platform can prevent that. Assume that anything you say or show to
    another person could be captured, and share accordingly.
web-recording.3eda2f906ae17135:
Whether you may record a conversation, and whose permission you need, depends on where you are
    and where the other people are. Some places allow one participant to record without telling the
    others.
web-recording.f7e671d776c696e7: Many require every participant to consent
web-recording.5bfa58251d5ad42d:
, and recording without that
    consent can be a criminal offence as well as a civil wrong. Rules can be stricter again for
    calls that are recorded for business purposes, for calls involving health or financial
    information, and for recordings that are later published.
web-recording.7b56d5e2005fa237:
Saathum cannot tell you which law applies to your call, and nothing on this page is legal
    advice.
web-recording.31f74b0ed1406594: 3. It is your responsibility to get consent
web-recording.bf6bc99a64b756f4: If you record, you are responsible for it.
web-recording.eada7e02ccbf50ae:
Before you start a recording, ask
      everyone on the call, say what you are recording and why, and stop if anyone objects. If you
      are recording somewhere that requires all-party consent, you must have it from all parties,
      not just an assumption.
web-recording.57dfaf71643f8c06:
You must not record covertly, must not keep recording after someone withdraws consent, and must
    not record where the law does not permit it. Recording a person for the purpose of harassing,
    blackmailing, or exposing them is a serious violation of our
web-recording.abf41ddaef553018:
, and recording intimate content without
    consent is prohibited absolutely. Anything involving a minor is covered by our
web-recording.74db962a9c566e86:
Where Saathum offers an in-app recording feature, we aim to make recording visible rather than
    silent: participants are shown an indicator or notice when a recording begins, and the
    indicator stays visible while recording continues. That notice is a courtesy and a signal — it
    is
web-recording.448bfbec814e2ba7:
a substitute for the consent the law may require you to obtain, and it
    does not make an unlawful recording lawful.
web-recording.9ebc79e6255a77b3:
If you see a recording indicator and you do not want to be recorded, say so, and leave the call
    if it continues. You can report it afterwards — see section 8.
web-recording.07898b3f8ceb4c02:
Saathum includes an AI receptionist that can answer a call for you when you are unavailable. If
    you turn it on:
web-recording.087de70462db5934:
The receptionist speaks with the caller, and audio from that conversation is processed so
      it can understand and respond.
web-recording.c4df0cdc4d98ff03:
Depending on the feature and your settings, Saathum may keep a transcript, a summary, or a
      recording of the conversation, so you can see what the caller wanted.
web-recording.e8fc7f43ec5e43ae:
Only the exchange with the receptionist is captured. If the call is then handed over to you
      and becomes a normal call, the ordinary rules in section 1 apply.
web-recording.a678663d09f125df:
Callers are intended to be able to tell they are speaking with an automated assistant. Do
      not configure the receptionist to deceive callers where disclosure is required by law.
web-recording.37bbf91a1f349e1c:
Turning the receptionist on is your decision, and the consequences for callers are your
    responsibility.
web-recording.ac23fca8ab914342:
Where the law requires callers to be told that a call is being
    recorded or handled by an automated system, that obligation sits with you as the account
    holder. If you are unsure, do not enable it. You can turn the receptionist off in the app.
web-recording.d42247188aa069a6:
Recordings, transcripts, and summaries created
      through Saathum are stored against the account that created them, and are subject to our
web-recording.e308ebbcf391be74:
. Some content is kept on your device; some is stored on
      our infrastructure so you can reach it from more than one device.
web-recording.1f0f25932748c5d3:
The account that made the recording, and anyone that
      account shares it with. Our staff do not routinely listen to recordings. We may access a
      recording where you ask us to for support, where we are investigating a report or suspected
      abuse, or where we are required to by law or valid legal process.
web-recording.102556c52ca75361:
For as long as you keep them, or as long as we need
      to provide the feature, meet a legal obligation, or resolve a dispute. Deleted items may
      persist briefly in backups before they are overwritten.
web-recording.da4a612dabdf19ae:
We do not use your recordings to train shared AI models without
      your consent.
web-recording.85a4f0960fe68645: We protect recordings using the measures described in our
web-recording.aaea93b5b72447a5:
Do not share, publish, post, forward, or sell a recording of another person without their
    consent — including clips, screenshots, and transcripts. This applies whether the recording was
    made on Saathum or somewhere else, and it applies even if the recording itself was lawful. A
    person consenting to be recorded is not the same as consenting to be published.
